name: shell-guard
description: Blocks shell commands that wipe your home folder, the project, disks, protected branches or databases, and snapshots uncommitted work to a git ref before commands that would destroy it.

mode.title: When a command is dangerous
mode.description: deny refuses it and tells the model why; ask sends it to the permission dialog with the reason instead.

protectedBranches.title: Protected branches
protectedBranches.description: Comma-separated branches that may not be force-pushed or force-deleted.

snapshots.title: Snapshot before destructive git and rm
snapshots.description: Save uncommitted work, untracked files included, to refs/shell-guard/<time> before git reset --hard, git clean -f, rm -r inside the project and the like.

extraDeny.title: Extra deny patterns
extraDeny.description: Regular expressions, one per line, matched against each command of a Bash call (prefixes like sudo stripped). A match is refused.
